The contributions are deductible only under the following conditions:

— The professional associations and interest groups must, in accordance with their statutes and actual management, be concerned exclusively or predominantly with safeguarding the professional interests of their members.

— The contributions may only be deducted in a reasonable amount as fixed in the statutes.

4. a) Contributions of the insured person to compulsory insurance under the statutory social insurance scheme.

b) Contributions to the supplementary pension insurance schemes operated by the Pension Institute of Linz Electricity, District Heating and Transport Company (Linzer Elektrizitäts-, Fernwärme- und Verkehrsbetriebe AG) and under the Federal Forestry Service Regulations (Bundesforste-Dienstordnung).

c) Compulsory pension (provident fund) contributions of employees of regional authorities and compulsory contributions of employees of public-law corporations to pension institutions, insofar as an obligation to participate in such a pension institution exists under public-law provisions.

d) Contributions based on statutory obligations of those under Section 25(1) point 4 and
